sourceAudit.summary: Realtor.com, Redfin, Zillow, Homes.com, and Movoto were audited. Four under-ceiling or at-ceiling candidates were added, two known listings were confirmed off market, and one known listing was confirmed sold. All records were deduplicated by address and MLS where corroborated.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Publicly indexed portal coverage is not exhaustive MLS coverage, and current status, square footage, MLS identifiers, and renovation details can conflict.

sourceAudit.summary: Indexed brokerage, listing-agent, public IDX, and builder inventory were checked. Coldwell Banker, public IDX pages, Homes.com, and MLS-fed agent pages corroborated new construction and current listing details.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Some IDX pages require registration, lag the source feed, or expose less history than national portals.

sourceAudit.summary: HUD Home Store, Fannie Mae HomePath, and Freddie Mac HomeSteps were checked for Rock Hill and nearby York County inventory; no current qualifying public candidate was identified.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Search indexing and inventory timing can lag; this is not a representation of exhaustive REO availability.

sourceAudit.summary: Zillow FSBO, York County Master in Equity, and York County delinquent-tax sources were reviewed. The two previously tracked FSBO candidates remain active. No new inspectable, currently priced foreclosure or tax-sale candidate qualified; the 2026 tax sale is scheduled for October 12 and the property list is not yet posted.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Auction, title, redemption, access, financing, condition, and legal-occupancy evidence remain mandatory before any distressed property could be recommended.

sourceAudit.summary: Auction.com, Hubzu, Xome, and public new-construction inventory were checked. No current auction met the status, layout, access, title, and price-evidence threshold. A newly tracked July 2026 build was retained with a current-status conflict and unresolved permit closeout.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Auction terms and title or inspection access were inadequate; new-build certificate of occupancy, warranties, and mandatory builder fees remain unresolved.

sourceAudit.summary: Canopy MLS Grid, Zillow Bridge, RentCast, BatchData, and ATTOM were not queried because the workflow uses public sources and does not obtain third-party credentials, paid keys, broker exports, or direct MLS access.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: The public discovery process cannot claim exhaustive MLS or paid-data coverage.

sourceAudit.summary: York County Assessor, One Map, Register of Deeds, and public-index routes were checked. Public listing pages exposed parcel identifiers and selected transfer or assessment history for several candidates.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Official parcel, current-owner, deed, lien, plat, tax-district, and post-lot-split readback was not retrievable for every candidate and remains follow-up evidence, not verified fact.

sourceAudit.summary: Rock Hill and York County permit, zoning, rental-registration, and development-report sources were checked. Public evidence identified a 2026 alteration permit at one new candidate and a 2025 lot-split review for another, but did not establish room-lease authority at any parcel.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific permit histories, legal bedroom counts, certificates of occupancy, zoning determinations, rental registration, and written separate-room lease authority remain unresolved.

sourceAudit.summary: FEMA Flood Map Service Center and York County One Map paths were checked; portal risk labels were treated only as screening prompts.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Property-specific FEMA or One Map flood determinations and insurance quotes were not reliably retrievable for every candidate and are not marked verified.

sourceAudit.summary: Public listing disclosures were reviewed for association presence and dues. One new candidate reports $85 annual dues, but no controlling declarations, amendments, bylaws, rules, budgets, resale certificates, or written management confirmation were obtained.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: Whole-unit and individual-room rental authority remains unknown for condominium or HOA-governed candidates; special, transfer, capital-contribution, builder, and mandatory fees remain unknown unless explicitly listed.

sourceAudit.summary: Zillow Rentals, Apartments.com, HotPads, and RentCafe were checked. Public one-bedroom asks start around $850 to $1,100 and extend above $1,600; HotPads reports a $1,398 one-bedroom average. The $1,150 private-unit planning benchmark remains conservative.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: These are public asking rents, not executed leases, and they may omit concessions, utilities, deposits, and mandatory fees.

sourceAudit.summary: Roomies, Furnished Finder, and SpareRoom were checked. Current conventional room asks in Rock Hill include roughly $700 to $950, with private-bath examples near $800 to $1,050. The configured $850 planning rent remains supportable but is viability-adjusted in underwriting.
sourceAudit.coverageGap: These are asking rents, not executed leases; property-specific demand, utilities, furnishing, parking, bathroom access, insurance, and lease length remain unverified.
